newsitem.title: GREECE: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE TO COMPETE IN ATHENS.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-GEBRSELASSIE TO COMPETE IN ATHENS.

text.p: Ethiopian Olympic 10,000 metres champion Haile Gebrselassie will compete in the world championships, International Amateur Athletic Federation president Primo Nebiolo said on Saturday.
Last week Gebrselassie said he would not run in Athens because the track was too hard for distance runners.
But Nebiolo said on his arrival in Athens: "We were informed today that Gebreselassie will run in the 10,000 metres."
